I’m the SDR on the account and would love to set up a 30-minute tailored demo to cover:
- A quick architecture sketch showing hosting options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- Typical latency/cost tradeoffs for inference at 1–5k QPS
- Security/compliance touchpoints (VPC, KMS, audit logs)

Would any of these windows work for you this week?
• Wed Jul 8, 10:00–10:30 PT
• Wed Jul 8, 14:00–14:30 PT
• Thu Jul 9, 11:00–11:30 PT

If none fit, pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/priya-30m

I’ve attached the webinar slides and a short one-pager so your team can skim before we meet. Who from your side should we include (architect, product, procurement)?

Best,
